description: Send the FULL amount of a succeeded Wave payment back to the customer (no partial refunds). The merchant's available balance must cover it. One refund per payment; the same idempotency_key returns the same refund.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

name: xaalis_refund_payment
title: Refund a payment in full
